data.name: Agro Racing
data.detailed_description:
Agro Racing is a third-person, combat-racing roguelike where you drive tractors through chaotic tracks. Face off against rivals and overcome unpredictable obstacles. After each win, upgrade your tractor with absurd tools and face off on a new random track. Combining pure mayhem, outrageous upgrades, and laugh-out-loud humor.

Key Features

  • Responsive controls and fluid movement focused on fun and chaos.

  • Use weapons and advantages to eliminate opponents and gain an edge during the race. Defend yourself with passive upgrades earned along the way.

  • Get stronger and more lethal with each race!

  • Each track brings unique surprises waiting for you.

  • If you don't make the podium, you're eliminated!

AGRO

Embrace a unique, cartoonish theme as you compete with other local farmers who want to take your land. Choose your favorite farm machine and use traps, speed, or brute force to dominate the competition!

A race decides if you'll earn more cattle or if you'll lose your farm and have to start over in the big city.

COMBAT

The combat system in Agro Racing combines real-time racing and action, with a focus on risk and reward management. Each tractor has a health value, and during races, your tractor can take damage from enemy attacks or track obstacles. If your tractor's health reaches zero, you are eliminated from the race and must restart the sequence from the beginning.

RACING

We feature an arcade racing system completely focused on fun! Race, jump, and plow through anything that stands between you and the finish line. Find alternative routes and get an advantage over your opponents.

ROGUELIKE

Upgrade your vehicle after each race!

Finish in the top three to avoid elimination, and at the end of each round, select upgrades that will make you more lethal. After each race, add new weapons and tools to your vehicle, adapting it to your playstyle.

data.short_description: With stylized low-poly 3D visuals and a tight third-person camera, Agro Racing combines combat-racing with a roguelike experience, where each race is more chaotic than the last. Upgrade your tractor with absurd tools, destroy your opponents, and claim the title of Cattle Baron!
